# Ozzy's Equipment Hire

> Melbourne-based hire company: VMS message-sign boards, full-colour LED trailer signs and mobile LED screen trailers, delivered, placed and programmed across Greater Melbourne and regional Victoria. Day rates from $45 per day ex GST; short hires of one to six days are a flat $500 plus 8% insurance.

Enquiries go through the quote form, phone (0469 316 068) or email. There is no online checkout and no account system. Each service below has its own page.

## Services

- [VMS sign hire in Melbourne](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/vms-sign-hire/): VMS sign hire in Melbourne from $45/day ex GST. Trailer-mounted variable message signs for roadworks, traffic management and events — delivered, placed and programmed across Victoria.
- [LED trailer sign hire Melbourne](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/led-trailer-sign-hire-melbourne/): LED trailer sign hire Melbourne from $45/day ex GST. Full-colour trailer LED signs for festivals, sport, retail and campaigns — towed in, positioned and collected across Victoria.
- [LED screen trailer hire](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/led-screen-trailer-hire/): LED screen trailer hire in Melbourne for outdoor advertising, event information and sponsor content. A 2.4 by 1.6 m full-colour mobile LED screen, delivered and set up across Victoria.

## Pricing

- [VMS and LED trailer hire prices](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/pricing/): VMS sign hire and LED trailer sign hire prices in Melbourne: from $45/day ex GST on a 12-month contract, or a flat $500 plus 8% insurance for one to six days. Live pricing calculator.

## Guides

- [How much does VMS sign hire cost?](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/vms-sign-hire-cost/): VMS sign hire in Melbourne runs from $45/day ex GST on a 12-month contract to $75/day under a month, or a flat $500 plus 8% insurance for one to six days. Full rate card and a worked example.
- [VMS board vs LED trailer sign vs LED screen trailer](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/vms-vs-led-trailer-sign/): Three jobs for one trailer: plain text as a VMS board for traffic, a fixed full-colour advert as an LED trailer sign, and moving content as an LED screen trailer. How to choose the right framing.
- [What size LED screen trailer do I need?](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/led-screen-trailer-sizes/): We run one screen trailer: a 2.4 by 1.6 metre full-colour screen at 4 mm pitch. What that size suits, how pixel pitch affects viewing distance, and when you need a bigger unit.
- [Traffic management sign rules in Victoria](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/traffic-management-sign-rules-victoria/): How VMS boards are governed on Victorian roads: the traffic management plan, road-authority permits, AS 4852, and what the hire company handles versus the customer.
- [Writing a VMS message that gets read](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/writing-a-vms-message/): A driver has to read a VMS board in one glance at speed. Keep frames to three short lines, use recognised wording, run two or three frames, and take the text from the traffic management plan.
- [Hiring an LED screen for a festival: a checklist](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/hiring-an-led-screen-for-a-festival/): Book two to three weeks out, confirm a level site clear of overhead lines with vehicle access, sort power for a longer hire, and have your content ready as image and video files.
- [Solar or mains power for a long hire?](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/solar-vs-mains-power-for-a-long-hire/): Short sign hires run on solar and battery. From about three weeks, or through overcast weather, plan for a 10A power point on site. The day rate does not change either way.
